title: Man Accused of Numerous Crimes Captured at Walmart
description:
A Florida man who was wanted for multiple accusations was arrested after allegedly trying to run away from police during a Walmart shopping trip. Officers took Joshua Comer, 35, into custody after a woman reported that he allegedly threatened to share explicit photos and videos of her. But that’s not all. While searching for Comer another nearby county allegedly sent out a BOLO for Comer in connection to a gas station robbery. It wasn’t long until Comer’s vehicle was spotted in a Walmart parking lot where his alleged crime spree would come to an end. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
